item.simplywings.wing.tooltip: Right-click to add these wings to your collection
gui.simplywings.title: Wings
gui.simplywings.stat_value.acceleration: %s m/s gained per second of beating
item.simplywings.bat_membrane.lore: A scrap of night stretched thin, still warm with the echo of a thousand blind turns.
item.simplywings.bat_membrane.riddle: Where bats flit through the dark, strike one down with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.crow_feather.lore: Black as spilled ink, it carries the sly laughter of the field thief.
item.simplywings.crow_feather.riddle: Reap ripe wheat with a winged tool: the crows were there before you.
item.simplywings.hushed_down.lore: So soft it swallows sound. The owl's prey never hears it coming.
item.simplywings.hushed_down.riddle: Under the moon, crouched and silent, slay a rabbit with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.gull_feather.lore: It smells of salt and long journeys, of shores that never end.
item.simplywings.gull_feather.riddle: Cast a winged fishing rod from a beach: the gulls will pay their toll.
item.simplywings.nectar_drop.lore: A single golden bead, sweeter than anything that walks the earth.
item.simplywings.nectar_drop.riddle: Pick a small flower with a winged tool and catch its hidden nectar.
item.simplywings.raptor_talon.lore: Curved like a promise. The mountain eagle never lets go.
item.simplywings.raptor_talon.riddle: High on the peaks, above Y 120, bring down a goat with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.updraft_shard.lore: A sliver of stone that the wind refuses to let fall.
item.simplywings.updraft_shard.riddle: Mine the bare rock above Y 150 with a winged pickaxe, where the updrafts live.
item.simplywings.swift_quill.lore: Sharp as a sickle and twice as quick. It hates standing still.
item.simplywings.swift_quill.riddle: Run! While sprinting, slay a chicken with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.homing_feather.lore: Plain and grey, yet it always knows the way home.
item.simplywings.homing_feather.riddle: Within the walls of a village, slay a chicken with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.peacock_plume.lore: A jungle jewel with an eye that watches back.
item.simplywings.peacock_plume.riddle: Deep in the jungle, slay a chicken with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.macaw_plume.lore: Red, yellow and blue, loud even in silence.
item.simplywings.macaw_plume.riddle: Break jungle leaves with a winged tool, where the parrots nest.
item.simplywings.royal_jelly.lore: The queen's own food. The whole hive will want it back.
item.simplywings.royal_jelly.riddle: Break a bee nest or beehive full of honey with a winged tool. Run.
item.simplywings.moth_dust.lore: Powder from wings drawn to every flame they ever met.
item.simplywings.moth_dust.riddle: At night, break a torch or a lantern with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.chitin_shard.lore: A fragment of shell, hard and green-black like a beetle's back.
item.simplywings.chitin_shard.riddle: Hunt the silverfish hiding in the stone with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.acorn.lore: A small promise of a great oak. Squirrels would fight for it.
item.simplywings.acorn.riddle: Break oak or dark oak leaves with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.fin_ray.lore: A ribbon of fin that remembers leaping over the waves.
item.simplywings.fin_ray.riddle: Fish with a winged rod in warm or lukewarm oceans.
item.simplywings.phantom_sinew.lore: A green nerve that still glows with sleepless dreams.
item.simplywings.phantom_sinew.riddle: Strike down a phantom with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.resonant_shard.lore: It hums when you hold it, a song only geodes know.
item.simplywings.resonant_shard.riddle: Break a fully grown amethyst cluster with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.verdigris_flake.lore: Green time, flaked off old copper.
item.simplywings.verdigris_flake.riddle: Break weathered or oxidized copper with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.fossil_fragment.lore: Bone turned to stone, older than any living thing.
item.simplywings.fossil_fragment.riddle: Break a bone block buried below Y 40 with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.raw_resin.lore: Sticky golden blood of the oldest pines.
item.simplywings.raw_resin.riddle: In an old growth taiga, cut spruce logs with a winged axe.
item.simplywings.ember_wisp.lore: A flicker of a blaze's soul that refuses to go out.
item.simplywings.ember_wisp.riddle: Slay a blaze with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.tide_pearl.lore: The sea's heartbeat, sealed in a pearl.
item.simplywings.tide_pearl.riddle: Slay a guardian with a winged blade; an elder guardian gives three.
item.simplywings.living_rock.lore: Stone from the deep that still breathes, very slowly.
item.simplywings.living_rock.riddle: Mine deepslate or tuff below Y 0 with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.gust_mote.lore: A wild breath of wind that never learned to sit still.
item.simplywings.gust_mote.riddle: Slay a breeze in the trial chambers with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.thunder_spark.lore: A crackling seed of the storm, snatched from a creeper's fuse.
item.simplywings.thunder_spark.riddle: During a thunderstorm, slay a creeper with a winged blade. A charged one gives more.
item.simplywings.polar_glimmer.lore: A shard of northern light frozen inside the ice.
item.simplywings.polar_glimmer.riddle: At night, in a snowy land, break ice with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.shade_wisp.lore: A curl of darkness with a violet glint where an eye should be.
item.simplywings.shade_wisp.riddle: In the dark, where the light is 7 or less, slay an enderman with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.stardust.lore: Dust from the far side of the sky.
item.simplywings.stardust.riddle: Slay a shulker in an End city with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.blossom_spirit.lore: A pink petal that dances even when there is no wind.
item.simplywings.blossom_spirit.riddle: Break cherry leaves with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.heavenly_down.lore: Down from above the clouds, lighter than a thought.
item.simplywings.heavenly_down.riddle: Up in the cloud layer, slay a chicken with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.vex_wing.lore: A tiny wing, torn from a tiny demon.
item.simplywings.vex_wing.riddle: Slay a vex with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.soul_wisp.lore: A blue whisper from the valley of the lost.
item.simplywings.soul_wisp.riddle: In a soul sand valley, dig soul sand or soul soil with a winged shovel.
item.simplywings.echo_resonance.lore: The echo of a scream, trapped before it faded.
item.simplywings.echo_resonance.riddle: In the deep dark, break a sculk shrieker with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.dragon_scale.lore: A scale of the End's ancient guardian, cold and unbreakable.
item.simplywings.dragon_scale.riddle: Slay the Ender Dragon with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.supple_hide.lore: Leather so soft it bends like a wing.
item.simplywings.supple_hide.riddle: Slay a cow, mooshroom, horse, donkey or llama with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.silk_thread.lore: Thread spun finer than any weaver's.
item.simplywings.silk_thread.riddle: Slay a spider or a cave spider with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.hollow_bone.lore: Light and hollow, the secret every bird keeps.
item.simplywings.hollow_bone.riddle: Slay a skeleton, stray or bogged with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.elastic_gel.lore: It stretches, snaps back and never tears.
item.simplywings.elastic_gel.riddle: Slay a slime or a magma cube with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.pristine_feather.lore: A flawless feather, as if it had never flown.
item.simplywings.pristine_feather.riddle: Slay any chicken with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.fleece_tuft.lore: Wool so thick it muffles the world.
item.simplywings.fleece_tuft.riddle: Slay a sheep with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.abyssal_ink.lore: Ink from the deepest blue, darker than any dye.
item.simplywings.abyssal_ink.riddle: Slay a squid or a glow squid with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.ghast_wisp.lore: The sorrow of a ghast, drifting on its own.
item.simplywings.ghast_wisp.riddle: Slay a ghast with a winged blade.
item.simplywings.sky_iron.lore: Iron that remembers the sky it fell from.
item.simplywings.sky_iron.riddle: Mine iron ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.copper_spark.lore: A bright spark trapped in raw copper.
item.simplywings.copper_spark.riddle: Mine copper ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.gilded_vein.lore: A thread of pure gold, still running through the stone.
item.simplywings.gilded_vein.riddle: Mine gold ore, in the Overworld or the Nether, with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.redstone_pulse.lore: A heartbeat of redstone that never stops.
item.simplywings.redstone_pulse.riddle: Mine redstone ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.lapis_glint.lore: A spark of the deep blue sky, hidden underground.
item.simplywings.lapis_glint.riddle: Mine lapis ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.emerald_sliver.lore: A green sliver from the mountains' hidden heart.
item.simplywings.emerald_sliver.riddle: Mine emerald ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.soot_flake.lore: Black dust from the oldest fires of the world.
item.simplywings.soot_flake.riddle: Mine coal ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.prism_shard.lore: A diamond splinter that splits light into colours.
item.simplywings.prism_shard.riddle: Mine diamond ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.pale_quartz.lore: White as bone, born in fire.
item.simplywings.pale_quartz.riddle: Mine nether quartz ore with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.ancient_ember.lore: An ember that has burned since before the Nether had a name.
item.simplywings.ancient_ember.riddle: Mine ancient debris with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.void_grit.lore: Grit from the edge of nothing.
item.simplywings.void_grit.riddle: Break end stone with a winged pickaxe.
item.simplywings.glimmer_spore.lore: A spore that glows to light its own way.
item.simplywings.glimmer_spore.riddle: Break glow lichen with a winged tool.
item.simplywings.glimmering_scale.lore: A silver scale that flashes like a fish in the sun.
item.simplywings.glimmering_scale.riddle: Fish anywhere with a winged rod.
item.simplywings.iron_harness.lore: Straps of leather and iron buckles: the first step to carrying wings.
item.simplywings.iron_harness.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Leather, Supple Hide, Iron Ingot, Silk Thread and Sky Iron Fleck.
item.simplywings.gilded_harness.lore: The old harness, reborn in gold for wings of spirit.
item.simplywings.gilded_harness.riddle: Of Gold Ingot, Leather, Iron-Buckled Harness and Gilded Vein, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.radiant_harness.lore: Diamonds set into gold, worthy of the gods' wings.
item.simplywings.radiant_harness.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Diamond, Phantom Membrane, Gilded Harness and Prism Shard.
item.simplywings.fury_saddle.lore: A saddle fit for a Night Fury. Hiccup would approve.
item.simplywings.fury_saddle.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Dragon Scale, Leather, Radiant Harness, Saddle, Ancient Ember and Netherite Ingot.
item.simplywings.gilded_frame.lore: A golden skeleton, warm with blaze fire, waiting for a wing.
item.simplywings.gilded_frame.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Gold Ingot, Blaze Powder, Gilded Vein and Ember Wisp.
item.simplywings.spirit_vessel.lore: A golden jar that holds what cannot be held.
item.simplywings.spirit_vessel.riddle: Of Gold Ingot, Glass and Ghast Wisp, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.celestial_frame.lore: A frame of light and diamond, made to carry heavenly wings.
item.simplywings.celestial_frame.riddle: Of End Rod, Void Grit, Diamond and Gilded Frame, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.blessed_plume.lore: A feather touched by the clouds, white as a blessing.
item.simplywings.blessed_plume.riddle: Of Feather, Heavenly Down, Pristine Feather and White Dye, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.bottled_gale.lore: A storm in a bottle. Do not uncork indoors.
item.simplywings.bottled_gale.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Gust Mote, Wind Charge and Glass Bottle.
item.simplywings.fury_plasma.lore: Blue fire, the breath of the fastest dragons.
item.simplywings.fury_plasma.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Dragon's Breath, Blaze Powder and Ghast Wisp.
item.simplywings.dragonbone_spar.lore: A spar of dragon bone, strong enough for a Fury's wings.
item.simplywings.dragonbone_spar.riddle: Of Dragon Scale, Celestial Frame and Ancient Ember, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.aurora_veil.lore: A veil of northern lights, folded small.
item.simplywings.aurora_veil.riddle: Bring Polar Glimmer, Glimmer Spore, Lime Dye and Purple Dye to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.bat_core.lore: The heart of a bat: a sonar that sees in the dark.
item.simplywings.bat_core.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Iron Ingot, Bat Membrane, Redstone Dust, Sky Iron Fleck and Sculk Sensor.
item.simplywings.bat_wing.lore: One leathery wing, stretched between long fingers.
item.simplywings.bat_wing.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Hollow Bone, Bat Membrane, Iron Ingot, Leather and Elastic Gel.
item.simplywings.crow_core.lore: The heart of a crow: clever, and a little greedy for shiny things.
item.simplywings.crow_core.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Iron Ingot, Crow Feather, Emerald Sliver and Spyglass.
item.simplywings.crow_wing.lore: One black wing with fingered tips.
item.simplywings.crow_wing.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Feather, Crow Feather, Ink Sac and Iron Ingot.
item.simplywings.owl_core.lore: The heart of an owl: patient eyes that see in the night.
item.simplywings.owl_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Book, Iron Ingot, Hushed Down and Golden Carrot.
item.simplywings.owl_wing.lore: One soft, round wing that makes no sound.
item.simplywings.owl_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Feather, Fleece Tuft, Hushed Down and Iron Ingot.
item.simplywings.gull_core.lore: The heart of a gull: it always smells of the sea.
item.simplywings.gull_core.riddle: Of Gull Feather, Iron Ingot, Raw Cod and Nautilus Shell, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.gull_wing.lore: One long, narrow wing, grey with black tips.
item.simplywings.gull_wing.riddle: Of Feather, Gull Feather, Abyssal Ink and Iron Ingot, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.hummingbird_core.lore: The heart of a hummingbird: it beats faster than you can count.
item.simplywings.hummingbird_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Iron Ingot, Nectar Drop, Sugar and Clock.
item.simplywings.hummingbird_wing.lore: One tiny blade of a wing, shimmering green.
item.simplywings.hummingbird_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Emerald Sliver, Sky Iron Fleck, Feather and Nectar Drop.
item.simplywings.eagle_core.lore: The heart of an eagle: it only looks up.
item.simplywings.eagle_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Raptor Talon, Iron Ingot, Updraft Shard and Rabbit's Foot.
item.simplywings.eagle_wing.lore: One great brown wing, fingers spread.
item.simplywings.eagle_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Feather, Gilded Vein, Iron Ingot, Brown Dye and Updraft Shard.
item.simplywings.swift_core.lore: The heart of a swift: it has never stood still.
item.simplywings.swift_core.riddle: Bring Swift Quill, Iron Ingot, Sugar and Updraft Shard to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.swift_wing.riddle: Bring Iron Ingot, Feather, Swift Quill and Charcoal to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.pigeon_core.lore: The heart of a homing pigeon: it always finds its way home.
item.simplywings.pigeon_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Iron Ingot, Paper, Homing Feather and Compass.
item.simplywings.pigeon_wing.lore: One slate-grey wing with two black bars.
item.simplywings.pigeon_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Feather, Homing Feather, Pristine Feather, Abyssal Ink, Light Gray Dye and Iron Ingot.
item.simplywings.peacock_core.lore: The heart of a peacock: proud, and a little vain.
item.simplywings.peacock_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Iron Ingot, Lapis Glint, Peacock Plume and Emerald Sliver.
item.simplywings.peacock_wing.lore: One wing and a long train of eyed feathers.
item.simplywings.peacock_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Peacock Plume, Feather, Cyan Dye, Lapis Glint, Iron Ingot and Gold Nugget.
item.simplywings.parrot_core.lore: The heart of a parrot: it dances to any music.
item.simplywings.parrot_core.riddle: Of Iron Ingot, Macaw Plume, Cocoa Beans and Note Block, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.parrot_wing.lore: One red, yellow and blue wing.
item.simplywings.parrot_wing.riddle: Of Macaw Plume, Red Dye, Yellow Dye, Lapis Glint, Pristine Feather and Iron Ingot, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.bee_core.lore: The heart of a bee: it beats for the hive.
item.simplywings.bee_core.riddle: Of Iron Ingot, Honeycomb, Royal Jelly, Honey Bottle, Sky Iron Fleck and Nectar Drop, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.bee_wing.lore: Two small translucent wings, a fore and a hind.
item.simplywings.bee_wing.riddle: Of Glass Pane, Silk Thread and Honeycomb, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.moth_core.lore: The heart of a moth: always drawn to the light.
item.simplywings.moth_core.riddle: Of Iron Ingot, Moth Dust, White Wool and Lantern, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.moth_wing.lore: Two powdery wings with a golden eye.
item.simplywings.moth_wing.riddle: Of Fleece Tuft, Moth Dust, Pink Dye, Brown Dye and Silk Thread, it is shaped at the Assembly Table.
item.simplywings.beetle_core.lore: The heart of a beetle: armoured and stubborn.
item.simplywings.beetle_core.riddle: Bring Iron Ingot, Armadillo Scute, Chitin Shard and Emerald Sliver to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.beetle_wing.lore: A green shell over a smoky wing.
item.simplywings.beetle_wing.riddle: Bring Armadillo Scute, Chitin Shard, Glass Pane, Iron Ingot and Green Dye to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.squirrel_core.lore: The heart of a flying squirrel: it plans every leap.
item.simplywings.squirrel_core.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Iron Ingot, Acorn and Rabbit Hide.
item.simplywings.squirrel_wing.lore: One furry membrane from wrist to ankle.
item.simplywings.squirrel_wing.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Stick, Rabbit Hide, Leather and Silk Thread.
item.simplywings.flying_fish_core.lore: The heart of a flying fish: half sea, half sky.
item.simplywings.flying_fish_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Iron Ingot, Fin Ray, Glimmering Scale and Tropical Fish.
item.simplywings.flying_fish_wing.lore: A translucent fin, silver and blue.
item.simplywings.flying_fish_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Fin Ray, Glass Pane, Light Blue Dye and Iron Ingot.
item.simplywings.phantom_core.lore: The heart of a phantom: it never sleeps.
item.simplywings.phantom_core.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Iron Ingot, Phantom Membrane, Phantom Sinew and Glow Ink Sac.
item.simplywings.phantom_wing.lore: One torn membrane, with glowing green veins.
item.simplywings.phantom_wing.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Hollow Bone, Phantom Membrane, Phantom Sinew and Iron Ingot.
item.simplywings.amethyst_core.lore: The heart of a geode: it hums a quiet song.
item.simplywings.amethyst_core.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Iron Ingot, Resonant Shard, Amethyst Shard and Calcite.
item.simplywings.amethyst_wing.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Amethyst Shard, Resonant Shard and Iron Ingot.
item.simplywings.ornithopter_core.lore: The drive of an ornithopter: a pulley, a piston and a dream.
item.simplywings.ornithopter_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Iron Ingot, Copper Spark, Piston, Copper Ingot and Updraft Shard.
item.simplywings.ornithopter_wing.lore: One wooden wing covered in canvas.
item.simplywings.ornithopter_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Stick, Fleece Tuft, Silk Thread and Copper Ingot.
item.simplywings.kite_core.lore: The reel of a kite: string, bamboo and a little wind.
item.simplywings.kite_core.riddle: Bring Silk Thread, Iron Ingot, Bamboo and Updraft Shard to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.kite_wing.riddle: Bring Bamboo, Paper, Red Dye and Silk Thread to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.copper_core.lore: The engine of a copper wing: it glows and ticks.
item.simplywings.copper_core.riddle: Bring Copper Ingot, Redstone Pulse, Iron Ingot and Copper Bulb to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.copper_wing.lore: One wing of riveted copper plates.
item.simplywings.copper_wing.riddle: Bring Copper Spark, Sky Iron Fleck, Piston and Verdigris Flake to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.patchwork_core.lore: A patchwork heart: stitched from whatever was at hand.
item.simplywings.patchwork_core.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Leather, Silk Thread, Iron Ingot, Red Wool and Pristine Feather.
item.simplywings.patchwork_wing.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Feather, Red Wool, Fleece Tuft, Green Wool, Leather, Stick and Silk Thread.
item.simplywings.fossil_amber.lore: Golden amber with something ancient sleeping inside.
item.simplywings.fossil_amber.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Raw Resin and Fossil Fragment.
item.simplywings.ancient_core.lore: The heart of the meganeura: amber that never forgot.
item.simplywings.ancient_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Fossil Amber, Gold Ingot and Torchflower.
item.simplywings.ancient_wing.lore: Two flat amber wings, veined with fossil brown.
item.simplywings.ancient_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Glass Pane, Fossil Amber, Gilded Frame and Brown Dye.
item.simplywings.fossil_spar.lore: A giant finger of stone bone, from a time of flying reptiles.
item.simplywings.fossil_spar.riddle: Bring Fossil Fragment, Gold Ingot and Hollow Bone to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.ochre_membrane.lore: Ochre skin, thin and tough, like the wings of the first fliers.
item.simplywings.ochre_membrane.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Leather, Orange Dye and Elastic Gel.
item.simplywings.ptero_core.lore: The heart of a pterosaur: older than the oceans it crossed.
item.simplywings.ptero_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Gold Ingot, Fossil Spar, Pitcher Plant and Nautilus Shell.
item.simplywings.ptero_wing.lore: One ochre membrane on a giant finger bone.
item.simplywings.ptero_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Fossil Spar, Ochre Membrane and Gilded Frame.
item.simplywings.living_flame.lore: A flame that breathes and moves on its own.
item.simplywings.living_flame.riddle: Bring Ember Wisp, Blaze Powder and Magma Cream to the Assembly Table, and it will take form.
item.simplywings.fire_core.lore: A heart of fire, trapped in a spirit vessel.
item.simplywings.fire_core.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Living Flame, Gold Ingot, Fire Charge and Spirit Vessel.
item.simplywings.fire_wing.lore: One wing of flame, yellow to red.
item.simplywings.fire_wing.riddle: The Assembly Table weaves it from Living Flame, Gilded Frame and Blaze Powder.
item.simplywings.flowing_tide.lore: Water that refuses to stay still.
item.simplywings.flowing_tide.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Tide Pearl, Prismarine Crystals and Prismarine Shard.
item.simplywings.water_core.lore: A heart of water that never stops flowing.
item.simplywings.water_core.riddle: Born at the Assembly Table, from Flowing Tide, Gold Ingot, Nautilus Shell and Spirit Vessel.
item.simplywings.water_wing.lore: One translucent wing of water, edged in foam.

commands.simplywings.no_item: Hold an item in your main hand
jei.simplywings.winged_energy.info: Place any item in the Winged Energy tab of the Assembly Table to imbue it, or to take the energy back. Imbued tools, weapons and fishing rods collect winged drops.
jei.simplywings.info.assembly_table: The Assembly Table stands in the Wing Forge, which appears far out in the End when a dragon dies for the second time (and is repaired at every later death). Follow the Forge Compass. The table assembles wings, crafts components on a 5x5 grid without corners, imbues items with winged energy, and stores up to 1000 Cloud Essence.
jei.simplywings.info.forge_compass: Given to every player on the central End island when a dragon dies, from the second dragon on. It points to the Wing Forge.
jei.simplywings.info.cloud_essence: Keep a Cloud Absorber in your inventory and fly through the Overworld cloud layer: empty Cloud Flasks fill up, 100 Cloud Essence each. Drop full flasks in the Assembly Table to fill its tank.
